subject: CloudSpire onboarding — COI endorsement timing, PO routing, and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudspire.io>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@cloudspire.io
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: CloudSpire onboarding docs (COI/W9/subcontractors)

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the intro — excited to get CloudSpire set up with Redwood. Attached: our current COI and W-9, plus a quick subcontractor roster you asked about.

Quick notes:
- COI attached (CloudSpire_COI.pdf) reflects our primary commercial general liability and professional liability.
- Endorsements (AI / Waiver of Subrogation) are handled by our broker and typically need ~7-10 business days to issue an amended endorsement.
- If you need the endorsement sooner we can request priority routing but it isn't guaranteed.

Action items for us: confirm what exact endorsement wording you need and whether a conditional PO can be issued while we secure the endorsement.

Attachments: CloudSpire_COI.pdf, CloudSpire_W9.pdf, CloudSpire_Subcontractor_List.xlsx

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships, CloudSpire Analytics
elena@cloudspire.io | +1 (415) 555-0124

------------------------------------------------------------

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@cloudspire.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSpire onboarding docs (COI/W9/subcontractors)

Thanks Elena — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few procurement items so we can move to PO issuance: 

1) COI requirements (we need confirmation that the COI meets all of the following):
   - Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
   - Professional Liability / E&O: $1,000,000 (or proof of umbrella that covers professional services)
   - Additional Insured endorsement: Redwood Inference, Inc. added as Additional Insured on CG 20 10 or equivalent wording.
   - Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood where permitted by law.
   - Policy effective dates that cover the expected engagement start date (we'll aim for the PO start date).

2) If your broker needs exact language, please ask them to use this wording as the Additional Insured: 
   "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, and employees are included as Additional Insured for ongoing and completed operations."

3) We also need:
   - Completed W-9 (you attached — thanks)
   - Subcontractor list (sheet attached) with % of scope for each subcontractor
   - If available, last 3-year claims summary (or a broker attestation that there are no open claims exceeding policy limits)

4) PO timing: our finance team can issue a conditional PO for up to 30 calendar days while the endorsement processes, provided the COI is valid today and we receive written confirmation from your broker that endorsement is in progress. Can you confirm you want us to proceed on that basis?

Next steps: I’ll loop in Procurement/Finance for the conditional PO if you confirm. Marcus — can you flag whether any billing pre-reqs block a conditional PO?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (510) 555-0199

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudspire.io>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@cloudspire.io
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 19:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSpire onboarding docs (COI/W9/subcontractors)

Thanks Grace — yes, we want to proceed and would appreciate a conditional PO while our broker issues the endorsement. A couple of clarifications: 

- COI we attached shows current limits (CGL 1/2M per occ, 2M agg) — looks like we are short on the CGL per-occurrence limit to meet the $1M requirement. We can request an endorsement/limit increase but that will be with our broker and may affect premium.
- Our broker will confirm timing on the AI endorsement; earliest realistic ETA is 7 business days if prioritized.
- Subcontractor list shows 2 partners and % scope columns; happy to expand if you need more detail.
- I attached the W-9 for finance.

If Redwood needs to hold to the $1M per-occ requirement, we can either:
  a) Request an endorsement/increase with our carrier (7–10 business days), or
  b) Provide a temporary certificate and accept a conditional PO with the understanding that final PO terms will be contingent on the endorsement/limit increase within 30 days.

Let me know how official Redwood prefers to proceed. We can also set up a 15-min sync with our broker if helpful.

—Elena

Attachments: CloudSpire_COI.pdf, CloudSpire_W9.pdf, CloudSpire_Subcontractor_List.xlsx

------------------------------------------------------------

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@cloudspire.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSpire onboarding docs (COI/W9/subcontractors)

Elena — thanks for the flag and for confirming you want the conditional PO. Procurement can issue a 30-day conditional PO while the endorsement/limit change is processed. A few operational items before we issue: 

- Marcus (Finance) — can you confirm whether the attached W-9 is sufficient for PO creation and whether a conditional PO will require any billing holds?
- Priyom (Legal/Contracts) — please confirm if the stated AI wording is acceptable or if we need legal to redline. If ok, we’ll proceed with the simple clause above.
- Elena — please send broker contact or a broker attestation email confirming: (1) requested AI endorsement is in progress, (2) expected ETA, (3) any limitations/conditions. That attestation can be emailed to procurement@redwood.com and will serve as evidence for the conditional PO.

Assuming finance signs off, next steps from our side:
1) Issue conditional PO (30 days) with a note that final payment and full onboarding are contingent on endorsement and/or limit increase.
2) Provide you a PO number and invoice routing instructions (electronic invoicing preferred).
3) Once we receive endorsement and confirm limits, we’ll finalize the PO and remove the conditional flag.

If you want to speed the endorsement, happy to join a short call with your broker. Otherwise, please send the broker attestation email and we’ll queue the conditional PO.

Thanks — Grace

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
procurement@redwood.com | +1 (510) 555-0199
